prompt.text: What were the five most common 311 complaint types in New York City in October 2026, and how many of each?

package.output:
**Top 5 NYC 311 complaint types in October 2026**

| Rank | Complaint Type | Number of Calls |
|------|----------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Illegal Parking | 59,708 |
| 2 | Noise – Residential | 35,425 |
| 3 | HEAT/HOT WATER | 26,454 |
| 4 | Blocked Driveway | 17,440 |
| 5 | Noise – Street/Sidewalk | 16,813 |

*Data source*: NYC 311 Service Requests dataset (`erm2-nwe9`) filtered to created_date from 2026‑10‑01 through 2026‑10‑31, grouped by complaint_type and ordered by count DESC (limit 5).
